title: rail_account.verified
description: Published by payments when a rail account turns active because a test call with its stored credentials worked (data model §7's Events table; task 4.3). The credentials themselves never appear in any event. This is the envelope's data field, not the whole envelope (see platform/events.Envelope).

tenant_id.description: The client the account belongs to; absent for VASPRO's own accounts.

verified_by.description: The staff member who ran the check.
